claims.claim: Sellected collection of books on marketing and sales
claims.evidence: Witness only reported a stack of paperback books with spines facing up; no titles/authors were readable in the report.

claims.claim: Original copies, not photocopies or local reprints
claims.evidence: No close-up of copyright page, publisher details, ISBN, or print quality was shown in the witness report.
No interior page photos were shown; witness only observed spines on a surface.

risks.risk: Titles/subjects may not be marketing & sales (or may be mixed genres), which changes demand and price.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the spines and/or a laid-out list showing author + title for each book (all spines fully readable).
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unspecified mixed paperback book bundle (worst-case: lower demand).

risks.risk: Not the complete set (unknown number of books; some may be missing).
risks.proof: A photo showing the full stack count from top to bottom, plus a photo of the full set laid out so every book is visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a partial bundle (worst-case: fewer books than expected).

risks.risk: Condition issues (cover wear, spine damage, page stains/tears, missing pages) that reduce resale value.
risks.proof: Close-ups of: front cover, spine, back cover, and 2–3 interior pages showing any stains/tears; include a photo of the page edges.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with possible wear (worst-case: damaged/dirty pages).

risks.risk: May be photocopies/reprints or non-original editions despite seller claim.
risks.proof: Photo of the copyright/publisher page and ISBN for at least 1–2 books (sharp and readable).

risks.risk: May contain writing/highlights/notes inside, contradicting the claim.
risks.proof: Photo of several interior pages (open book shots) showing margins and any underlines/highlights/handwriting.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possibly written-in (worst-case: marked pages).

proof_requests: Clear, readable photo(s) of every book spine (no overlap) showing author + title.
Photo showing the full bundle count (all books visible) to confirm completeness.
Close-ups of cover/spine/back for condition assessment.
Open-book interior photos (at least 2 books) showing pages for stains/tears and whether there is writing/highlighting.
Photo of the copyright/publisher page and ISBN for at least 1–2 books to confirm original editions.
response.reason: The witness confirms only that it is a stack of paperback books; specific titles, edition/original status, completeness, and interior condition are not verifiable from the report. I will price at the worst-case used paperback bundle scenario until the missing proof is provided.
